app#pairing.title: Pairing with the app: Pairing
app#pairing.text: Hold the wifi button for five seconds until it flashes, then choose Add appliance in the app. It needs a 2.4 GHz network.

app#language.title: Pairing with the app: Language
app#language.text: Hold the menu button for three seconds to change the display language.

blender-care#cleaning.title: Using your blender: Cleaning
blender-care#cleaning.text: The jug and lid can go in the top rack of a dishwasher. The blade unit must be washed by hand.

blender-care#blades.title: Using your blender: Blades
blender-care#blades.text: Use the flat blade for nuts and milks and the cross blade for ice and frozen fruit. Run it for no more than 60 seconds at a time.

cancel-order#before-dispatch.title: Cancelling an order: Before dispatch
cancel-order#before-dispatch.text: You can cancel at no cost until the order is dispatched. The money goes back to the card you paid with in three to five working days.

cancel-order#after-dispatch.title: Cancelling an order: After dispatch
cancel-order#after-dispatch.text: Once it has been dispatched we cannot stop it. Refuse the parcel at the door, or return it within 30 days.

change-address#before-dispatch.title: Changing a delivery address: Before dispatch
change-address#before-dispatch.text: We can change the address until the order is dispatched. After that the courier can only redirect it to a neighbour or a pick-up point.

change-address#safe-place.title: Changing a delivery address: Safe place
change-address#safe-place.text: You can name a safe place, such as a porch, until the morning of delivery.

damaged-items#tell-us.title: Items damaged in delivery: Tell us
damaged-items#tell-us.text: Tell us within seven days and attach a photo of the damage and of the box. You do not need to send the item back until we ask.

damaged-items#what-we-do.title: Items damaged in delivery: What we do
damaged-items#what-we-do.text: We send a replacement the same day if it is in stock, or refund you in full.

delivery-times#standard-delivery.title: Delivery times: Standard delivery
delivery-times#standard-delivery.text: Standard delivery takes three to five working days and is free on orders over £40. Below £40 it costs £3.95.

delivery-times#next-day-delivery.title: Delivery times: Next day delivery
delivery-times#next-day-delivery.text: Order before 8pm for next day delivery, Monday to Saturday. It costs £6.95. Large items such as ovens and fridges cannot go next day.

delivery-times#if-it-is-late.title: Delivery times: If it is late
delivery-times#if-it-is-late.text: If your order has not come two working days after the date we gave, we treat it as late. We open a search with the courier, which takes up to three working days. If it is not found we send another or refund you, whichever you prefer.

discounts#codes.title: Discount codes and gift cards: Codes
discounts#codes.text: Codes must be entered before you pay and cannot be added later. One code can be used on each order. Student codes do not work on sale items.

discounts#gift-cards.title: Discount codes and gift cards: Gift cards
discounts#gift-cards.text: Gift cards last two years. If a gift card does not cover the order, pay the rest by card.

faulty-items#first-30-days.title: Faulty items: First 30 days
faulty-items#first-30-days.text: If something stops working in the first 30 days, you can have a refund or a replacement.

faulty-items#after-30-days.title: Faulty items: After 30 days
faulty-items#after-30-days.text: After 30 days and within the guarantee we repair it, or replace it if it cannot be repaired. Repairs take up to ten working days.

faulty-items#error-codes.title: Faulty items: Error codes
faulty-items#error-codes.text: E1 means the water tank is empty. E4 means the heater has cut out: unplug it, leave it 30 minutes and try again. If E4 comes back, book a repair.

guarantee#what-is-covered.title: The two year guarantee: What is covered
guarantee#what-is-covered.text: Every appliance has a two year guarantee from the day it was delivered. It covers parts and labour for faults in normal home use.

guarantee#what-is-not-covered.title: The two year guarantee: What is not covered
guarantee#what-is-not-covered.text: Accidental damage, wear to filters and seals, limescale damage and commercial use are not covered.

guarantee#registering.title: The two year guarantee: Registering
guarantee#registering.text: You do not have to register. Keep your order number or receipt as proof of purchase. The guarantee passes to a new owner with the receipt.

kettle-care#descaling.title: Looking after your kettle: Descaling
kettle-care#descaling.text: Descale every four weeks in a hard water area. Fill to half with one part white vinegar to one part water, boil, leave an hour, rinse and boil twice with fresh water.

kettle-care#filter.title: Looking after your kettle: Filter
kettle-care#filter.text: The limescale filter lifts out of the spout. Rinse it weekly.

longer-cover#adding-a-year.title: Extending your cover: Adding a year
longer-cover#adding-a-year.text: You can add one more year of cover for £14 within 60 days of delivery.

missed-delivery#what-the-courier-does.title: Missed deliveries: What the courier does
missed-delivery#what-the-courier-does.text: The courier tries twice on different days. After the second try the parcel waits at a pick-up point for seven days.

missed-delivery#booking-another-day.title: Missed deliveries: Booking another day
missed-delivery#booking-another-day.text: Use the link in your delivery text to choose another day, a neighbour or a pick-up point.

oven-settings#timer.title: Oven settings: Timer
oven-settings#timer.text: Press the clock twice, turn the dial to the time you want and press the clock again.

oven-settings#symbols.title: Oven settings: Symbols
oven-settings#symbols.text: The snowflake is defrost: the fan runs without heat. The fan in a circle is fan oven. Two lines are top and bottom heat.

payments#two-payments.title: Payments and invoices: Two payments
payments#two-payments.text: If you see two payments, one is usually a hold that the bank drops in three to five days. If both are marked complete after that, we refund one.

payments#vat-invoices.title: Payments and invoices: VAT invoices
payments#vat-invoices.text: Download a VAT invoice from your account under Orders.

payments#price-match.title: Payments and invoices: Price match
payments#price-match.text: If our price drops within seven days of your order, we refund the difference. We do not match other shops.

refund-times#timing.title: When refunds arrive: Timing
refund-times#timing.text: We refund within two working days of your return reaching our warehouse. Banks then take three to five working days to show it.

refund-times#expired-cards.title: When refunds arrive: Expired cards
refund-times#expired-cards.text: If your card has expired, the bank passes the refund to your new card. If the account is closed, tell us and we will send a bank transfer.

refund-times#part-refunds.title: When refunds arrive: Part refunds
refund-times#part-refunds.text: A refund is smaller than you paid if a part was missing from the return or the item was used beyond testing.

returns#how-long-you-have.title: Returns: How long you have
returns#how-long-you-have.text: You have 30 days from delivery to return anything, for any reason. You do not need the original box, but the item must be protected in the post.

returns#how-to-send-it-back.title: Returns: How to send it back
returns#how-to-send-it-back.text: Print a free label from your account, or show the code at a parcel shop. We collect large items such as ovens and fridges free of charge.

returns#opened-items.title: Returns: Opened items
returns#opened-items.text: Opened items can be returned if they are clean. Personal care items cannot be returned once opened unless they are faulty.

safety#smoke-sparks-or-shocks.title: Safety: Smoke, sparks or shocks
safety#smoke-sparks-or-shocks.text: If an appliance smokes, sparks, smells of burning or gives a shock, switch it off at the wall, unplug it if it is safe to, and do not use it again. Contact us and a person will call you the same day.

safety#extension-leads.title: Safety: Extension leads
safety#extension-leads.text: Do not run heaters, kettles or ovens from an extension lead.

vacuum-care#lost-suction.title: Looking after your vacuum: Lost suction
vacuum-care#lost-suction.text: Empty the bin, then wash the foam filter in cold water and dry it for 24 hours. Check the hose for blockages.

vacuum-care#how-often.title: Looking after your vacuum: How often
vacuum-care#how-often.text: Wash the filter once a month.
